story: Aiko is in her quiet kitchen. She usually adds sugar to the bowl. The gray sky is outside the open window. Dan is late for the important party. He brings a nice gift for dear Aiko. He puts the heavy bag on his back. Every person always eats the cake. The sound of the glass is too loud.
title: A Quiet Party
setting: A cozy kitchen with an open window.

characters.name: Aiko
characters.look: a young woman with short black hair and a white apron

characters.name: Dan
characters.look: a tall man with brown hair and a blue shirt

sentences.en: Aiko is in her quiet kitchen.
sentences.zh: Aiko 在她安静的厨房里。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a young woman with short black hair and a white apron, stands in a quiet kitchen.

sentences.en: She usually adds sugar to the bowl.
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko pours white sugar from a jar into a large bowl.

sentences.en: The gray sky is outside the open window.
sentences.zh: 灰色的天空在敞开的窗外。
sentences.scene_prompt: A view through an open kitchen window shows a gray sky.

sentences.en: Dan is late for the important party.
sentences.zh: Dan 参加重要的聚会迟到了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan, a tall man with brown hair and a blue shirt, walks toward the kitchen door.

sentences.en: He brings a nice gift for dear Aiko.
sentences.zh: 他为亲爱的 Aiko 带来了一份美好的礼物。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan holds a small gift box with a red ribbon near Aiko.

sentences.en: He puts the heavy bag on his back.
sentences.zh: 他把沉重的包放在背上。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan adjusts a heavy bag on his back.

sentences.en: Every person always eats the cake.
sentences.scene_prompt: A group of people are eating cake at a table.

sentences.en: The sound of the glass is too loud.
sentences.scene_prompt: A glass cup falls onto the table making a loud sound.
